neighbours.label: First person singular: 'I' or 'my' in a writer's account of their own doing, versus the same sentences with we/our, you/your or they/their
fire: I switched my phone plan in March and the bill went down.
I built a small questionnaire to learn how I might help my readers more.
Can someone tell me what I need to fix the crack in my bathroom wall?
So perhaps only a glitch while updating my profile or something similar.
Last month I sold my car and started taking the bus.
I started a blog to figure out how I can manage my savings.
Please explain what I ought to say at my sister's wedding.
I closed my old bank account yesterday and everything went smoothly.
